ONNX_INT8.deployment_complexity: Medium (4x smaller artifact, ONNX Runtime CPU)

recommendation.rationale: ONNX Runtime INT8 dynamic quantization reduces model artifact size by 74.8% (449 MB -> 113 MB) and delivers substantial CPU latency improvements (up to ~1.5x forward speedup) while maintaining ranking quality parity on the benchmark dataset without violating candidate upper bounds.
recommendation.caveat: The reranker remains strictly offline in T260037. Production integration requires asynchronous pipeline batching or worker thread offloading to prevent event-loop blocking.
